locator: PubMed abstract; indexed PMC Results excerpt and Fig. 2 description
population: Adults in Zhengzhou, China, after local COVID-19 lockdown
exposure: Statement of the proportion of urban-district respondents planning a restaurant visit over the weekend
target: Subsequent estimate of neighbors' actual restaurant visits
result: Initially below-truth estimates shifted upward by 4.64 percentage points (95% CI 0.97 to 8.31); above-truth estimates shifted downward by 10.9 points (95% CI -15.46 to -6.52).
limitations: Message described plans; outcome asked about actual visits. One setting and topic. Behavior effects are separate outcomes and are not evidence for this exact endpoint.

locator: Abstract, Objectives/Method/Results; descriptive-only feedback arm versus attention control
population: 1,137 undergraduates at two universities reporting at least one recent heavy episodic drinking occasion
exposure: Web-based personalized descriptive normative feedback containing reference-group drinking information
target: Perceived descriptive drinking norms at 3, 6 and 12 months
result: All four intervention arms, including descriptive-only feedback, reduced perceived descriptive and injunctive norms relative to attention control; most active-arm comparisons were not significant.
limitations: Personalized normative feedback bundles a prevalence claim with own-behavior and discrepancy comparison; heavy-drinking college population and alcohol-specific norm.

locator: Publisher abstract and indexed discussion excerpt
population: Adults initially disinclined toward colorectal cancer screening
exposure: Statements with different true screening-uptake percentages, sometimes with feedback on the participant's prior estimate
comparator: No uptake information or alternate prevalence statement
target: Screening intention; perception of communicated norm examined as manipulation check
result: Higher-than-expected uptake messages raised intention among initially disinclined recipients; explicit personalized prior-estimate feedback showed no added benefit for the reported intention outcome.
limitations: Intention is not PSY-016. The null added-feedback result is on intention, not a supported null for perceived norm. Full exact norm-estimate contrast was not extracted.
